SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen sat down with Atreides Management CIO Gavin Baker on Day 1 of the TomorrowX Summit at the Moody Center in Austin, Texas. 

Key points from the interview were:

- Orbital compute: First orbital compute satellites fly next year, constellation ramps in 2028, and "meaningful volume in the gigawatts" arrives in 2029. Johnsen expects orbital to be cheaper per GW than terrestrial within 1–2 years. Starship catch is the critical unlock. In orbit there are essentially zero operating costs (no energy, cooling, or land bills)—the main expense is getting the hardware up. SpaceX is already in the low-to-mid $30/watt range vs. >$50–60 for the rest of the world.

- Terrestrial compute & funding: Demand is rising from "almost every player in the industry." SpaceX can stand capacity up quickly (shell + power in months, racks online in days) and acts as a spot-market player, capturing higher returns and flexibility. Hosting deals often show <1-year payback; much of the massive capex can be funded from internal operating cash flows.

- Starlink Direct-to-Cell: Satellites fly next year with the goal of true 5G-quality service from space to unmodified cell phones in the first half of 2028. U.S. regulatory pieces are in place; work continues with global regulators and existing carriers.

He also covered Flight 15 learnings, second-stage catch, GrokBot/software tools, next Grok versions, and community impact.

Here is my Tesla Lithium Refinery Flyover in Robstown, Texas. This is North America’s first industrial-scale acid-free spodumene-to-lithium-hydroxide facility. 

This plant converts imported spodumene concentrate (SC-6, ~6% lithium oxide) into battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate using a proprietary alkaline process (no sulfuric acid). The finished product is trucked to Giga Texas to supply the cathode plant for 4680 cells used in Cybertruck, Cybercab, Semi, and future Optimus.   

Key locations are the spodumene concentrate Receiving & Storage Warehouse, Kiln + Cooler (α-spodumene → β-spodumene), Alkaline Leach (lime + soda ash) Purification & Crystallization facilities, and the Packaging & Shipment facility.  

What you see is Phase 1. The site was deliberately sized for a future Phase 2. Tesla is advancing closed-loop battery recycling plans involving black mass recovery. A facility for this could be coming soon.   

This facility 100% supports Tesla’s vertical integration and domestic battery materials supply chain.

NEURALINK: Today the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office issued U.S. Patent 12,797,514 B2, "Cell-Based Brain-Machine Interface," to Neuralink. It covers a brain-computer interface built from genetically modified neurons grafted onto the surface of the brain!

Neuralink's current N1 implant reads the brain only through electrode threads inserted into tissue. In this design, living cells grow the connections into the brain themselves.

The modified BCI is grafted above cortical layer 1. The graft forms a new, artificial outermost layer called "layer zero" (L0). According to the patent, axons and dendrites from L0 grow into the host cortex "nondestructively" and form the synaptic connections needed for "bidirectional communication with the brain." 

In the patent's tests on adult mice, the graft first produced waves of synchronized activity that gradually settled into normal-looking brain activity. 

In the main claim, a camera images the graft to read signals from the brain, and a light source sends signals back in. Other claims tether the cells to electrodes.

Possible benefits include:

- Bidirectional communication with L0 cells that can both send and receive signals through synapses, which may support more natural input and output than unidirectional electrode recording.

- Potentially lower tissue damage over time because the connection is made by living cells that infiltrate the cortex possibly avoiding some of the chronic inflammation and scarring associated with rigid or high-density electrodes.

- Developmental integration of engrafted cells that gradually produces activity patterns resembling natural cortical activity, which could improve long-term signal stability and biological compatibility.

- Higher effective resolution through many synaptic connections. In principle is could allow finer-grained interaction with neural circuits than the number of physical electrodes alone.

Neuralink originally filed the application on December 8th, 2021, and the twelve inventors include Neuralink co-founder Max Hodak, now co-founder and CEO of Science Corporation, and Alan Mardinly, a former Neuralink leader who is now co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer at Science Corporation.
tweets.text_zh:
NEURALINK：今天，美国专利商标局向 Neuralink 颁发了美国专利 12,797,514 B2，“基于细胞的脑机接口”。它涵盖了由移植到大脑表面的转基因神经元构建的脑机接口！

Neuralink 目前的 N1 植入物只能通过插入组织的电极线读取大脑信息。在这个设计中，活细胞将连接生长到大脑本身。

改良的 BCI 被移植到皮质层 1 之上。移植物形成一个新的人造最外层，称为“零层”(L0)。根据该专利，来自 L0 的轴突和树突“非破坏性”地生长到宿主皮层中，并形成“与大脑双向通信”所需的突触连接。 

在该专利对成年小鼠的测试中，移植物首先产生同步活动波，并逐渐形成看起来正常的大脑活动。 

在主要权利要求中，摄像机对移植物进行成像以读取来自大脑的信号，并且光源将信号发送回。其他权利要求将细胞束缚在电极上。

可能的好处包括：

- 与 L0 细胞进行双向通信，可以通过突触发送和接收信号，这可能支持比单向电极记录更自然的输入和输出。

- 随着时间的推移，可能会降低组织损伤，因为连接是由渗透皮质的活细胞建立的，可能避免与刚性或高密度电极相关的一些慢性炎症和疤痕。

- 移植细胞的发育整合逐渐产生类似于自然皮质活动的活动模式，这可以提高长期信号稳定性和生物相容性。

- 通过许多突触连接实现更高的有效分辨率。原则上，与单独的物理电极数量相比，它可以允许与神经回路进行更细粒度的交互。

Neuralink 最初于 2021 年 12 月 8 日提交了申请，12 名发明人包括 Neuralink 联合创始人马克斯·霍达克 (Max Hodak)，现任 Science Corporation 联合创始人兼首席执行官，以及前 Neuralink 领导者、现任 Science Corporation 联合创始人兼首席科学官 Alan Mardinly。

Here is my Tesla Lithium Refinery Flyover in Robstown, Texas. This is North America’s first industrial-scale acid-free spodumene-to-lithium-hydroxide facility. 

This plant converts imported spodumene concentrate (SC-6, ~6% lithium oxide) into battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate using a proprietary alkaline process (no sulfuric acid). The finished product is trucked to Giga Texas to supply the cathode plant for 4680 cells used in Cybertruck, Cybercab, Semi, and future Optimus.   

Key locations are the spodumene concentrate Receiving & Storage Warehouse, Kiln + Cooler (α-spodumene → β-spodumene), Alkaline Leach (lime + soda ash) Purification & Crystallization facilities, and the Packaging & Shipment facility.  

What you see is Phase 1. The site was deliberately sized for a future Phase 2. Tesla is advancing closed-loop battery recycling plans involving black mass recovery. A facility for this could be coming soon.   

This facility 100% supports Tesla’s vertical integration and domestic battery materials supply chain.

THE BORING COMPANY HQ: Bastrop, Texas, October

Here is my flyover of TBC's Bastrop headquarters and Prufrock factory. It's is where they test every machine before it ships, build and store equipment, precast tunnel segments, liner trucks, vertical cassettes and conveyor belt systems, and more. They house their Prufrock Command Center here to control all the Prufrock's soon to be around the world.

- The SpaceX Pedestrian Tunnel started as Porpoise Test 6 (PT6). TBC first bored it to test (no people in the tunnel) ZPIT continuous mining, an upgraded liner truck and the "SNAILS on RAILS" navigation system. After the test, they turned it into a 500 ft walkway under FM1209 that connects the SpaceX site to Hyperloop Plaza, where The Boring Bodega is. People use it so they don't have to cross that busy road on foot.
 
- Hard-rock Prufrock-MB4 being constructed for Nashville's Music City LOOP.

- The Test Tunnel PT5 connects SpaceX's Starlink factory to TBC under FM1209. It was the first use of custom hexagonal segments, automated gantry steering, quick craneless retrieval, and the first version of ZPIT. It's now a test bench for liner trucks, vertical cassettes and new belt systems.

- Hyperloop Test Tunnel was PT4; the first craneless, pitless retrieval of the machine. It's now a vacuum tunnel for Hyperloop vacuum pump system testing. It also connects SpaceX's Starlink factory to TBC under FM1209.

- Lastly, Prufrock-5 after completing a test tunnel connecting Ring Ranch and possibly the SpaceX Starmind Factory. I videoed it right before it was loaded up and shipped to San Antonio, Texas, for the Morgan's Wonderland Tunnel.

If you have any questions, leave them in the comments. Subscriber Photo-thread and Support links in the thread.

Thanks for watching!

SPACEX: The Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) tested Rocket Cargo point-to-point delivery on the October 20th Bandwagon-5 launch via SpaceX’s Starfall reentry capsule. 

AFRL agile cargo pods inside the capsule carried a SATCOM-enabled tracker, batteries, a reverse osmosis desalinator, survival gear, and emergency medical equipment, with sensors measuring temperature, shock, and vibration during launch and reentry. 

Engineers also fit-checked a UNI-PAC III life raft for possible future use. The test evaluates whether commercial rockets can rapidly deliver critical supplies worldwide to sites without roads or runways, supporting future military resupply, rescue operations, and disaster relief.

Per Brig. Gen. Douglas P. Wickert, AFRL commander and Department of the Air Force Technology Executive Officer, "Today’s launch was another demonstration of how AFRL is partnering with industry to burn down risk, collect hard data and deliver war-winning technologies for the operational force."

Per Adam Remaly, Director of AFRL Technology Transition Office, "This was a critical achievement to demonstrate the potential of Rocket Cargo delivery for point-to-point rapid global mobility for the Future Force."

TESLA: Today at 1 p.m. CT Fort Bend County commissioners will consider four agreements for Tesla’s proposed ~$10.1 billion vertically integrated solar cell and module manufacturing plant, Project Crystal Sun. 

The agreements cover:

- Property Tax Abatement Agreement between Fort Bend County and Tesla located in Precinct 2, Reinvestment Zone No. 34. in a Precinct 2 reinvestment zone.

- Chapter 381 Economic Development Agreement between Fort Bend County, Texas and Tesla to encourage investment and job creation in Fort Bend County.

- Foreign Trade Zone Site Non-Objection and Payment in Lieu of Certain Taxes Agreement between Fort Bend County, Fort Bend County Drainage District, and Tesla, and authorize the County Judge to execute the Non-Objection. Fort Bend County payments under this Agreement would be deposited into the County General Fund and Fort Bend County Drainage payments would be deposited into the Drainage District Operating Account.

- True Up Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) Agreement between Fort Bend County and Tesla with all payments under this Agreement to be deposited into the County General Fund.

Lamar CISD already approved a related 10-year JETI school property tax limitation in September. The meeting was at 1 p.m. at the Fort Bend County Courthouse, 401 Jackson St., Richmond.
